headline: Last Warden Post Falls in Linn Mercy as Gutter Erupts
war_summary: The final Warden post in Linn Mercy has fallen since the last edition, leaving Colonial forces in command of ten of that region's eleven strategic bases, the eleventh a ruined no-man's-land. Fighting has not ceased there: three actions in the past two hours, the latest within the hour of filing, while the past day's losses pass 8,800 Colonial and 15,800 Warden, though the pace has eased. Palantine Berm stays warm at five posts Colonial to two Warden — twenty-six actions in the day, four inside two hours, the latest near five o'clock. The Gutter has flared anew: a base at Suojus fell to Colonial forces within the day, the latest action logged before four o'clock, with two-hour losses of 78 Colonial and 117 Warden and rates still climbing. The Nevish Line remains bitterly contested, seven Warden posts against one, casualties near 230 Colonial and 170 Warden an hour and rising, six actions logged at Grief Mother. The Weathered Expanse has seen no ownership change in nearly ten hours, yet two-hour losses still top a thousand apiece and the day's ledger passes 11,200 Colonial and 13,000 Warden, with two posts in ruin. Mooring County and Marban Hollow have gone quiet since the small hours. Day 589 of the war; thirty-four victory towns required; no victor named.
